title: Second Attempt
description: A declined card shouldn't be a dead end — SwiftCargo lets the customer retry with a different card (FR-1004). Decline a payment, then retry with a valid card, and verify the full attempt history is preserved rather than overwritten.
successCondition: After a first POST /api/billing/invoices/:id/pay with the decline test card and a second with a valid card, GET /api/billing/invoices/:id/payments returns exactly two payments in order, with attemptNumber 1 (status "declined") and attemptNumber 2 (status "succeeded"), and GET /api/billing/invoices/:id shows the invoice as "paid".
hints: Each call to POST /api/billing/invoices/:id/pay on an open invoice creates a new Payment row rather than overwriting the previous attempt — check the DB's payments table directly if you want to verify beyond the API response.
The decline test card number is documented in docs/api/billing.md.
